lines.en: I wag my tail clumsily
I shift along the shallow seabed
The shield on my head is heavy
My mouth is open, always open
Sand passes out through my gill pores
I swim slowly along the reef
I have no jaw, I cannot close
I brush past a patch of kelp
The water is shallow, light reaches me
I drift a little with the current
Heavy-headed, I swim crooked
I wiggle forward
I have no fins, I can only twist

lines.zh: 浅海的颜色落在我甲上
lines.en: Pale water color rests on my shield

lines.zh: 我从一块石头边挤过去
lines.en: I squeeze past a stone
I push the seabed sand aside
I swim very slowly, very straight
My mouth always faces the current
I rest on the sand, mouth open
Water flows in through my mouth
There are fine lines on my shield
The shallow light wavers
I lie flat on the shallow seabed.

lines.zh: 有一点细碎的东西漂过来
lines.en: Something tiny drifts past
I stay still, like a shell
I can see on both sides at once.
Sand has covered half of me
I wait for food to enter my mouth
My tail keeps moving
The water here is calm
A layer of fine sand covers me

lines.zh: 有个小贝壳落在我旁边
lines.en: A little shell lands beside me
The water's clouded and I can't see you.
I have no teeth and no jaw
Looking up at you is hard work

lines.zh: 我只吃水里最小的东西
lines.en: I eat only the smallest things in the water
Your feet are stirring up sand
My armor is wedged in a rock crevice.
This armor of mine is heavy
You are bigger than the reef

lines.zh: 水流把你身上的味道带过来
lines.en: The current brings your smell
My mouth is open out of habit
I rolled over
There is a new mark on my shield
I dodged clumsily
My back plate has a dent in it.
Grains of sand are stuck in my armor seams.
My mouth is open, I cannot even cry out
I wiggle away
The water spins me around
I have no teeth, I can only endure
That one I remember

lines.zh: 有点细碎的东西漂过来
lines.en: Something tiny is drifting over
I need not bite, only open my mouth
That is too small, I cannot see it
The current will bring it in
I turn my open mouth toward it
That is a little bigger than sand
I wait with my mouth open
Do not stir the water
It is in my mouth
I need not even chew
You stepped on me on the seabed
My shield made you slip
I rolled over and righted myself
I am not good at dodging

lines.zh: 沙子把我们两个都埋了
lines.en: The sand buried us both
I wiggle clumsily away
That pressed me against the reef
My tail swept your leg
I shift slowly aside
The water's buoyancy helped me
There are many of us in the shallows
I find them by taste in the water
Two clumsy fish together
Shield against shield, and we have met
We do not chase, we drift
There are many small ones in the sand
Two mouths open in the shallows
Neither of us looks at the other
The current separates us
Tomorrow we will still be here
I open my mouth and swallow it
This is stuck in my mouth
I have no teeth, I cannot swallow it
I have no jaw, so I only suck.
It is bigger than my mouth
I push it aside
This little bit is just right
Sand went in with it
I shake my head to throw it off
What sinks to the bottom is mine
There are tiny things in the water
I wait for the current to bring me food.
Those specks are drifting this way

lines.zh: 我张着嘴等水送来食物。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let the water bring food.
The current is going the right way
I turn slowly
Something in the sand moved
This distance is right for filtering
The sand on the shallow floor is shifting.
Opening my mouth is enough
I wait close to the sand
The specks come nearer
Even my tail slows
The water pushes them to my mouth
I need only stay still
The lined shield keeps the sand off
They move in and out
I open a little wider
This mouthful is faint
Enough to last me a day
I butt with my shield
My shield pushed you
That was very clumsy
I slap the water with my tail
All I can do is butt with my armor.
The shield got there first
I twisted and missed
I ram your boot with my head shield.
The water surface splashes apart
I retreat to the stone
I settle onto the shallow seabed
My mouth has been open all along
The shallow seas of the Ordovician are here.
My shield is still new
I come from Ordovician water
I swished my tail twice.
The sand gives under my weight

lines.zh: 礁石边上多了一个小影子
lines.en: A small shadow appears by the reef
I try to lift my head, and cannot
I shift away along the seabed

lines.zh: 我从浅海的沙里露出来
lines.en: I rise out of the shallow sand
Fine sand still clings to my shield

lines.zh: 水暖得发烫，我往深处去
lines.en: The water warms painfully, I go deeper

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，砸进沙里
lines.en: I drop from above and hit the sand
I am in water, but this water is wrong

lines.zh: 爆炸把海底的沙都掀了
lines.en: The blast threw up the seabed sand

lines.zh: 飞来的东西砸在我的甲上
lines.en: Something flying struck my shield
That force came through the water at me

lines.zh: 水里没有小东西，我饿着
lines.en: Nothing tiny in the water, and I starve

lines.zh: 雷顺着水过来，我全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning came through the water and I go numb

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的甲很重
lines.en: No water in the void, and my shield is heavy
